typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	WriteReconRunDatatoPROD_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CreatedBy as string,
		ReconciliationID as integer,
		Source1RecordCount as integer,
		Source2RecordCount as integer,
		CreateTimestamp as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetReconRunDatafromlowerenvironment
GetReconRunDatafromlowerenvironment sink(input(
		CreatedBy as string,
		ReconciliationID as integer,
		Source1RecordCount as integer,
		Source2RecordCount as integer,
		CreateTimestamp as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CreatedBy,
		ReconciliationID,
		Source1RecordCount,
		Source2RecordCount,
		CreateTimestamp),
	partitionFileNames:[($WriteReconRunDatatoPROD_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> WriteReconRunDatatoPROD
